policy: RESIDENTIAL DWELLING INSURANCE / Policy wording "WD-2026" - Repair Scope and Building Services Edition
description: A power surge damaged two air conditioning units in the house — one in the living room, one in the kitchen — along with some other connected equipment. Both AC units needed replacing, one of them mounted on a floor-standing console. Replacement parts had to be shipped in, and a technician came out afterward to install everything and check the wiring.
